content: Nu̱tyuramusiy riryi vichasara Ju̱denu dadyeñumiy
Ramuni̱ jirye̱cha Ju̱denu jantyavay jiryatiy jiryeñi̱cha sadadyeñu jaryi va̱tasavay.

Jirya̱ma̱ vichasara jaryi va̱ta̱damu, daryatiy sava̱ta̱da Crístu daryá vu̱y, sasa̱yada variyu, sa̱tidye batye vuryeyadaju̱. Su̱ntatya̱da paru̱cha̱rimyusiy Ju̱denumuju̱yu, jiryatiy su̱mutya̱jada Ju̱denura su̱ntatya̱da, nu̱tyu vu̱rudi jaryi ju̱rura saju̱.
Jiryetyi rañi̱cha Ju̱denu vicha̱damu, ne jirya̱nique cadnavedanchiñu̱ndye, dantyamu̱y ne va̱cha jvaayadanchiy, dantyamu̱y ne jaryi tara canuyadacanuminchiy, tapi ratatiy jirya̱jarupanu variñi̱ ti̱.
Daryantyamu̱y ne jirya̱niquera nicyara̱y niquejada, datyi̱sa̱damu niquejada, jamiryamu niquejada jarye, mitya. Jirya̱nique ji̱tara niquejada ratatiy jiryi̱chana̱tya̱da ni̱ Ju̱denu.

Jirya̱datya samiy daryaju̱ra jirya: Ni̱tiy vichasara cadnavu̱, varimyata vaturu̱y cadnatoda, varimyata va̱cha jvaarya, varimyata tara sa̱chara canuyadacanu, jiryatiy sasiityari̱ Ju̱denu jiyasachirya tara, ne sa̱jmutya̱sara mityara jiyaru̱rya Crístu nusu̱jyomu, jasityi sa̱nsu̱chara Ju̱denu ni̱.
Ne jirya̱quivu̱chutaniy mitya niquejadatayu, tapi darya jvaayadaco̱siy ra̱jti̱ Ju̱denu nique̱yada jaryi riyaro̱ju̱ rityimyu̱ ne tuva̱churu̱y simu.
Ramuni̱mu̱y ne jirye̱cha rusa̱ rupivye darya vicha̱damu.
Ta̱riñuma jirye vichanu̱yada nupocudinube, diye ji̱ta jiryevyichasara Vu̱yntyityu̱musiy vandamu. Jirya̱vichasara samirya nu̱tyu Ju̱denu dadyeñumiy.
Vandamu rupiyadamusiy ru̱nday ti̱ta̱ju̱ jiryatiy samiryara, jiryatiy vase jaryera, jiryatiy si̱tenu jarye risa̱ju̱ra.
Jirya̱ma̱ jantya jvaayadara jiryatiy samirya Ju̱denu diya darya.
Ne jirya̱jvaay mityiji rusa̱ rityi jvaay nupocudinubera jiryatimyu̱ ne samirya Ju̱denu diya darya. Jirya̱sipyata ji̱ta nupocudinubesirya va̱cha jvaayada, no̱no̱muju̱.
Jadasara ji̱tara vu̱ñiquejada ranchiy jiryatiy ruvaachara dutya̱damusirya.
Ti̱ta̱ju̱ sipyatasaranumatiy vandamuju̱ darya, ra̱ma̱cho̱ ti̱ta̱ju̱ vandamu variy.
Ti̱ta̱ju̱ jvadicharanuma no̱no̱damu darya. Ramuni̱tiy ru̱tay variy:

content.text: Ya̱numa jidyo ma̱yadacanu, ya̱numa mi̱sa̱sumiy diibyimiy cabyimusiy, sa̱nó̱no̱nú̱y Crístu variy yiva.

content: Ramuni̱day, jiryi̱nu̱tyata̱ta samirya jiryevyicha̱da. Ne jirye̱chasara datyi̱sa̱miy, jirye̱cha ji̱ta datyavay.
Jiryedyetyata̱ta samiy ramitya̱dara jiryevyicha̱da jiyu, jiryatiy nicyara̱y vicha̱da daryaju̱ diye.
Ne jirye̱cha datyi̱sa̱miy nu̱ndye, jirya̱ma̱ datyara Vu̱yntyityu̱ ni̱ru̱yada.
Ne jirya̱niyu̱ñu̱day, jiryatiy jarapu̱chara daryaju̱ darya. Jirya̱ma̱ vichasara mu̱chanichavay Ju̱denu jnutumusiy.
Jirya̱niqueta nu̱ñi vajyuu murra̱yadatayu, jiryatiy vu̱myurra̱y Ju̱denunijyu̱ Su̱ntumusiy. Jirya̱murra̱chara ti̱ta̱ju̱ jijechitya jirya̱tidye jchana̱tya ratani̱ Vu̱yntyityu̱ variy.
Jirya̱jchana̱tyajaya̱ni̱ Vu̱jye̱ Ju̱denu ti̱ta̱ju̱ riva jiryatiy samirya darya, rivantiy jiryatiy ne samirya rani̱chantiy, Vu̱yntyityu̱ Jesucrístu jtyamu jirya̱jchana̱tya variñi̱.
Nu̱tyura saryi vichasara Ju̱denu siityari̱nu jiryorimyu, nu̱tyura
Jirya̱tuva̱chu nu̱ñi ti̱quimusiy yimu, jiryatiy jiryechuvu̱ñi̱ Crístu.

Vatuy, jirya̱tuva̱chu jaryi ruumu jivyaduy, nu̱tyu Vu̱yntyityu̱mu vu̱tyuva̱chu daryantiy, tapi sabayada Ju̱denu ni̱ vanu nu̱tyu nutyityu̱ savaturaju̱, daryani̱ savicha Crístu jichiityari̱vajyuu nutyityu̱ntiy, jiryatiy riyada rá̱ñuni̱. Ni̱ni̱ vicha nu̱tyu ru̱no̱, riy ji̱ta nu̱tyu savu̱ nta varidye.
Nu̱tyu Crístu siityari̱vay tuva̱chusara yimu, daryani̱ rirya̱tuva̱chusara vatuy ruumu jivyaduntyidye.

Vadumyijerye ra̱va̱tasara jaryiñada jivyaturu̱y, nu̱tyu Crístutiy va̱tanu̱yada darya riy jichiityari̱vajyuu, sabatyeda variy riyadaju̱, jiñi̱ru̱yadamu, sa̱tidye jiintya variy jijyu̱ daryi, jiryatiy sapu̱yada daryaju̱ ruuvasirya jijyuuchuveda, jiryatiy riityu̱yada Ju̱denu niquejadamu tuva̱chuvay ja̱a̱mu.

Sivaayada daryá sa̱tidye jnutatya yimuju̱ riy, jaryi vandamu vichavay, ne rirye̱cha vatajo̱ tavay, dantyamu̱y ne tara nicyara̱y baya̱sara riñijyu̱, dantyamu̱y ne nicyara̱tyavay, mitya. Sava̱ta rirye̱cha jiintyevye jijyu̱, ne javatyasavay, mitya.
Nu̱tyu vaduy jantyutyara jivyu̱, sani̱ru̱y jaryiyu, daryaday saryi jantyutya nada jivyaturu̱ntyi, saryi ni̱ru̱y jaryi nadantidye. Tapi ni̱tiy va̱ta nada jivyaturu̱y, sava̱ta variy daryantidyeyu.
Ne ti̱ javittyurya jivyu̱; sapotyaniy ji̱tayu, daryatiy su̱nu̱tya Crístu riy jichiityari̱vajyuuntiy jiryatiy vuryi̱tay savu̱ daryi.
Vu̱y jarye vichasara savu̱tera variy.
Darya su̱teda:

content.text: Ramuni̱, sa̱tochiy vanuni̱ jijye̱, su̱no̱da jarye, sa̱tidye ja̱mu̱y jivyaturaju̱ variy, danu̱ju̱myusiy nana̱chasara nu̱tyu ti̱qui variy.

content: Jirya ji̱ta jaryi ti̱ttasara datyanusara daryaju̱ darya, jiryatiy dutyasara ravichanu̱yada. Rani̱day su̱teda Ju̱denu Crístunijyu̱, sasiityari̱vajyuu nijyu̱ jarye.
Darya ri̱tesiy jiryejyu̱ntidyerya jirya niquejadantidye: Nu̱ñi ti̱qui vanu ra̱va̱ta nada jivyaturu̱y nu̱tyu sava̱ta jaryintyidyeyu, daryaday vatujyu̱ntiy, rirya̱bay samirya riy jivyaduy.
